tonight.headline: Tuten is questionable — and nobody behind him plays after noon
body: Bad news first: Tuten was limited Wednesday (ankle/foot) and ESPN lists him QUESTIONABLE. Your bench has no back with a game after 12:00 — Marks is ruled out Thursday, Jacobs is out and on bye — and Rice and Odunze lock at 12:00, before Jacksonville's 13:55 inactives. Whether to start him has to be decided before noon, from Friday's report.
ESPN projects 128.2 to 116.8 and gives you 56%. The lineup as set is the projection lineup. Taylor plays first, Thursday 19:15, with no designation.

case.body: Tuten inactive at 13:55 with Rice already locked — about 17 projected points to zero. The fallback card sets the rule.

case.body: Aaron Jones (MIN, Sunday night, free agent, 8.5) would be a live 13:55 fallback, but the seat would be Marks' (open thesis, nothing tripped) or Jacobs' (back 25 Nov). Not for a back who played through this last week.
